_comment: Quiz helpers and hindrances. A helper makes your own question easier; a hindrance makes theirs harder. Every team draws three at the start of the game, and the winner of a matchup draws one more. Forest-themed so they make good physical tokens.

items.name: Owl's Counsel
items.effect: Two wrong answers are removed from your question.

items.name: The Congress of Crows
items.effect: Ask the party. You may take the loudest answer or ignore it.

items.name: The Nurse Log Almanac
items.effect: Skip this question and take another.

items.name: Shed Antler
items.effect: Hear their answer before you give yours.

items.name: Fog
items.effect: They must answer first, out loud, with no conferring.

items.name: The Hum
items.effect: They have ten seconds. Count out loud.
